Now reaching the twilight of his career, this tournament represents the crowning achievement of his playing career – and Curaçao’s hopes of causing an upset may rest upon the influence of their captain.

Simply reaching the competition is a historic achievement in itself for Curaçao. Advancing from a difficult group would rank amongst the greatest upsets in the tournament’s history, but the Blue Wave have already shown throughout qualifying that they are capable of exceeding expectations.

A place in the knockout rounds would represent a major surprise, but even if their journey ends in the group stage, Curaçao will hope to leave the tournament having earned respect through their competitiveness and resilience.
